title: Using Tessl init for existing projects
description:
Got an existing project and want to bring in the power of Tessl? You're in the right place! 🚀

This short tutorial shows you exactly how to initialize Tessl on a project you're already working on. In just a few simple steps, you'll be set up and ready to go.

We cover:

- Navigating to your existing project directory.
- Running the Tessl init command.
- What happens next: setting up your agent!

It's the perfect starting point for integrating Spec Driven Development into your current workflow.

Join the AI Native Development (AIND) Community!
Get support, share ideas, and connect with other developers: https://tessl.co/4ghikjh
